Raj: noticing a spike of 503s from embeddings on the dedupe route, started ~14:03 UTC
DeployBot: deployment 2026-03-23T14:01Z started: release/embeds-quant-v2 -> canary
Amanda: rolled quant patch into canary earlier today — seeing unexpected mem growth?
Raj: errors are customer-facing, ~20% of requests get 5xx on canary hosts
Ops Oncall: checking infra now, KV cache eviction rate is through the roof on canary nodes
Mei: quant path increases activation size; on smaller GPUs it's causing OOM-ish behavior (GC spikes)
Noah: recommendation: expedite rollback to embeds-quant-v1 and pin stable image across canary+stable
Amanda: I approve expedited rollback for hotfix window, :thumbsup: (Amanda)
Ops Oncall: I also approve, will execute rollback and watch health checks
DeployBot: executing rollback command: `/deploy rollback release/embeds-quant-v2 --target stable --reason "mem+5xx spike"`
DeployBot: rollback in progress -> reducing canary traffic and promoting v1 image
Raj: starting smoke tests against stable after rollback begins
Mei: creating GH issue: "quant-v2 mem regression" and tagging eng-ml for follow-up
Noah: quick note for release notes: hotfix = revert quant-v2; impact = transient 5xx for dedupe route; mitigation = rollback to v1
Ops Oncall: rollback completed, health checks green, 5xx rate back to baseline
Amanda: great. can someone pin embeds-quant-v1 in Dedicated pools to avoid auto-update?
DeployBot: pin applied: `image:embeds-quant-v1` on dedicated pools
Raj: monitoring post-rollback for 15m, will file incident doc if noise persists
Mei: follow-up: schedule a controlled re-test on a beefier node with memory profiling before any re-roll
Noah: I'll draft a short release note and post to #release-notes; tag customers affected
DeployBot: closed rollout release/embeds-quant-v2 -> rolled back to v1
Raj: thanks all — smooth coordination. catching up in postmortem tomorrow
